assessment: This manuscript describes experiments using heterologous expression to achieve molecular dissection of the effects of PIP2 and CaVβ2 auxiliary subunits on CaV2.1 (P/Q-type) calcium channels. The experiments also probe interplay between lipid effects and other modulatory pathways. Understanding the functional regulation of this channel is important because CaV2.1 channels play significant roles in neuronal plasticity.
